# The PyPI wheels tests/server/deployMobilynetPythonNativeLibs.integration.test.js installs, with no index and
# each checked by its SHA-256, from $VIBE64_LANGUAGE_RUNTIME_TEST_ROOT/python-wheels, a folder made once on the test
# host with
#   pip download --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --python-version 3.13 --platform manylinux_2_28_x86_64 \
#     -r tests/fixtures/python-native-wheels.txt -d "$VIBE64_LANGUAGE_RUNTIME_TEST_ROOT/python-wheels"
# numpy, pandas and scipy are manylinux wheels whose native code takes libstdc++.so.6, libgcc_s.so.1 and libz.so.1
# from the system; the rest are what pandas needs, as pip resolved them on 21 Nov 2026.

python-dateutil==4.0.0 --hash=sha256:a5e246f79eb80475e691bf93862cead98decd8a498cf53ba0516fcdc0f50dc1c
tzdata==2026.6 --hash=sha256:0a10eec6e13ef16b627fabed9a5f2ba61a62b1c67f327305f4e7e412a70b4aec
